## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the issue and what changes for users. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

Describe builds/tests performed. For hardware changes, name the monitor/GPU/connection actually checked and confirm that original brightness was restored. For UI changes, include screenshots and accessibility checks.

## Resource and compatibility impact

Call out idle CPU/memory changes, added dependencies or timers, settings/install changes, and any remaining limitations. Remove sections that do not apply.
